## Bug Description

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

> Please do NOT include secrets, confidential source files, API keys, credentials, or raw sensitive logs in your report.

## Reproduction Steps

1. Create a markdown file with `...`
2. Run command `...` (or open slide preview)
3. See error or visual issue

## Minimal Reproduction Markdown

```markdown
---
title: Minimal Reproduction
theme: default
---

# Slide Title

- Reproduction content
```

## Expected Behavior

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

## Environment Details

- OS: [e.g. macOS 15.0 / Windows 11 / Ubuntu 24.04]
